name: random-topic-generator
description: *Cadence** is a modern, web-based tool designed to help individuals overcome public speaking anxiety and improve their impromptu speaking skills. By providing a random topic, enforcing a strict 60-second time limit, and utilizing AI-driven feedback, Cadence acts as your personal speech coach.

paragraphs: Cadence is a modern, web-based tool designed to help individuals overcome public speaking anxiety and improve their impromptu speaking skills. By providing a random topic, enforcing a strict 60-second time limit, and utilizing AI-driven feedback, Cadence acts as your personal speech coach.
features: Random Topic Generation: Pulls from a curated list of topics across various categories (e.g., Philosophy, Science, Everyday Life) and difficulty levels.
Time Pressure Simulation: A strict 60-second countdown timer helps eliminate filler words and teaches you to get straight to the point.
Audio & Video Recording: Practice using just your voice, or enable video to review your body language and eye contact.
AI Speech Analysis: Get instant, personalized feedback on your speech's structure, vocabulary, and delivery, along with a performance score out of 100.
SEO Optimized: Fully optimized for search engines with semantic HTML, rich meta tags, Open Graph data, and on-page FAQ content.
